0022600097.text: The Wizards, 1-0 and 2nd in the Southeast, host the 1-0 Raptors, who are 2nd in the Atlantic, half a game back, and 4th in the East, while Washington sits 5th in the East. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Wizards lost the season series 1-2, including a 134-125 defeat in Washington on February 28, 2026.
